pages.title: Cedar Grove Plumbing
pages.description: Friendly residential plumbing in Greater Victoria. Leak repairs, drain clearing and water heater installation with written estimates.

sections.heading: A comfortable home starts with plumbing you can trust
sections.text: Our Victoria team helps homeowners fix leaks, restore drains and plan sensible upgrades. We explain the work and agree on a price before we begin.

image.alt: Workshop tools arranged for a home repair

items.title: Leak repairs
items.description: From dripping taps to hidden supply-line leaks, we find the source and explain your repair options.

items.title: Drain clearing
items.description: Careful clearing for slow sinks, tubs and household drains, with advice to help prevent the next blockage.

items.title: Water heaters
items.description: Tank replacement and maintenance sized to your household, including removal of the old unit.

sections.heading: Your neighbours since 2016
sections.text: Cedar Grove is a small, locally owned team led by licensed plumber Rowan Chen. We protect floors, clean up our work area and leave you with a clear record of every repair.

items.quote: Rowan found the leaking connection, explained the repair and left the kitchen spotless. The written estimate made everything easy.
items.author: Maya L.

items.quote: The team arrived on time and had our laundry drain running again that morning. Friendly service from start to finish.
items.author: Daniel R.

sections.heading: Tell us what needs fixing
sections.text: Call during our opening hours to describe the problem and arrange a visit. If water is actively leaking, turn off the supply valve while you wait.

pages.title: Services
pages.description: See Cedar Grove Plumbing's repair, drain and installation services, starting rates and answers to common booking questions.

sections.heading: Repairs and upgrades with no guesswork
sections.text: We inspect the issue, explain the options and provide a written estimate. Work starts once you are comfortable with the plan.

items.name: Diagnostic visit
items.description: Inspection and a written estimate. Credited toward approved repair work on the same visit.

items.name: Tap or toilet repair
items.description: Labour for common repairs; parts priced separately in your estimate.

items.name: Drain clearing
items.description: Accessible household drain clearing. Camera inspection is quoted separately if needed.

items.question: Do you offer overnight emergency service?
items.answer: We take appointments during our listed hours. For an active leak outside those hours, shut off your home's main water valve and contact a 24-hour emergency provider.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We work in Victoria, Oak Bay, Saanich and Esquimalt. Call with your address so we can confirm availability.

items.question: Can I send a photo of the problem?
items.answer: Yes. Email a clear photo with your phone number and a short description. Photos help us prepare, though the final estimate follows an on-site inspection.

pages.title: Contact
pages.description: Call or email Cedar Grove Plumbing to book a repair in Victoria, Oak Bay, Saanich or Esquimalt.

sections.heading: Let's arrange your visit
sections.text: Have your address, a description of the issue and your preferred appointment days ready. Our office is open for scheduled visits; please call before stopping by.
